Hi Lesley, 
The Apple TV & iPad Pro aren't available to preorder yet. The watch I need more info for (see 
below). Bella needs to preorder the phone. 
I. The new Apple TV will be available in late October. No announced date for preorders, yet. 
Important to note on the Apple TV is that there is no longer a separate audio output —
everything goes through the HDMI cable. If the projector or tv that it's plugged into 
doesn't support audio-over-HDMI, it won't work. 
I'm not sure if any of the current setups rely on the optical audio cable going to a separate 
receiver currently, but they will need to be reconfigured to work with the new model. 
2. The iPad Pros will be available in November. No date announced for preorders, yet. 
3. On the watch.... there are so many options here designed to suit personal preferences, so I 
need a little more information... 
Do we know who the watch is for / which model and band he wants? Is this a gift? Does 
he just want one to play around with? 
All models come in either 38mm (1.52" H x 1.31" W) or 42mm (1.65" H x 1.41" W). Visually 
the 42mm looks considerably bigger than the 38mm version. 
Low-end Sport models arc $349+ aluminum, have the Gorilla Glass (same as iPhones) and the 
colors are: 
o Silver 
o Black 
o Rose Gold (color) 
o Yellow Gold (color). 
Sport models come with rubber bands available in White, Orange, Blue, Black, 
Lavender, Stone (light grey), Midnight Blue colors. 
Standard model is $549+, stainless steel with sapphire glass screens and the colors are: 
EFTA_R1_00634024 
EFTA02071845
--- PAGE 2 ---
o Silver 
o Black 
Standard models come with the following bands: 
o sport rubber bands (in red, white, or black), 
o leather with a classic buckle (brown or black), 
o leather with a "modern buckle" (midnight blue or pink), 
o magnetic "leather loop" band (midnight blue or stone), 
o stainless steel Milanese loop band (steel color only), 
o stainless steel link band (in steel or black) 
The "Edition" model is 510,000+, an 18-karat gold (custom alloy), with sapphire glass screens 
and the colors are: 
o Rose Gold 
o Yellow Gold 
Edition models come with the following bands: 
o sport rubber bands (in white or black) 
o leather with a "modern buckle" (red, rose grey [dusty rose?]), 
o leather with a classic buckle (black or midnight blue)

Okay, what you need is to create URLs (Uniform Resource Locators) 
to the images, instead of relative file paths. 
Dropbox explains how to do this here: https://www.dropbox.comien/help/167 
Show instructions for the platform used by the creator of the spreadsheet, then use 
the relevant method to copy the link, & paste it into the spreadsheet. 
(This means if Daphne doesn't have Dropbox installed already, you'll 
need to do that for her.) 
<Screen Shot 2015-10-01 at 2.18.54 PM.png> 
As long as it's a URL hyperlink, when the viewer clicks it, it will hurl to a web 
browser to view the contents of the file or folder. Folders of images in 
Dropbox create slick gallery allowing you to click through them (see 
EFTA_R1_00634750 
EFTA02072130
--- PAGE 2 ---
my demo 
here: futps;//www.dropbox.com/sh/4jumgmb9f7hb93i/AABnEJG2Dg 
dWulgvNQYyPUAba?d1=0 — yes, all my photos are of cats). 
This means 
• the boss doesn't have to install Dropbox to view the images, 
• you're not downloading images to his computer without him 
knowing 
• the folders don't need to be "shared" 
• the links will work on all platforms (windows, OS X, iPhone / 
iPad, Android, etc.)
